t: Mona Agarwal won gold in the women's 10m air rifle (SH1) at the 2026 Asian Para Games in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan, with a Games-record 250, ahead of Avani Lekhara (silver, 249.6), giving India its first medals of the Games.

Vishvajit More won silver in men's Greco-Roman 55 kg at the U23 World Wrestling Championships in Las Vegas, India's first Greco-Roman final and silver at that event, losing 12-13 to Georgia's Koba Karumidze.

With RBI approval, HDFC Bank's board appointed Anup Bagchi (till then MD and CEO of ICICI Prudential Life Insurance) as MD and CEO for three years from 27 October 2026, succeeding Sashidhar Jagdishan.
Defence Minister Rajnath Singh represented India at the 25th meeting of the SCO Council of Heads of Government in Dushanbe, Tajikistan, on 19-20 October 2026.

Fisheries scientist Dr B. Madhusoodana Kurup, founding Vice-Chancellor of the Kerala University of Fisheries and Ocean Studies (KUFOS) and former director of CUSAT's School of Industrial Fisheries, died at 71 in Kochi.
All-India CPI (retail) inflation for September 2026 on base 2024=100 was 5.54% (provisional; rural 6.08%, urban 4.88%); food inflation (CFPI) was 7.74%.
